changes: Fixed missing weapon-drop markers on the minimap and expanded map. Nearby weapons now appear in Midrath and dungeons.
In multiplayer, picking up a weapon leaves its marker visible to teammates for as long as their game still shows it on the ground.
Fixed missing tiles on the minimap and expanded dungeon map.
Improved player tracking when starting or updating Overkot mid-dungeon.
Reduced duplicate profile requests across some features.
Improved player-location detection on Windows when running Soulframe and Overkot without administrator privileges.
Fixed a misleading “Log in to Soulframe” message that could appear while you were already in Midrath.
Added Copy tracking report under Settings → Overlay → Player location to help diagnose slow searches. Settings also explains what to do when Windows denies access.
Both maps and affected cards in the Widgets menu now link to Settings → Connections when sign-in is needed. Missing tiles, item images, and icons load automatically after sign-in.
Fixed an issue that prevented some icons from loading.

Improved overlay shortcuts. Bind a single key or a key combination to interact with Overkot or show and hide it. On Windows, you can also bind mouse buttons, wheel clicks, scrolling, and wheel tilt. Existing shortcuts are preserved, and key combinations remain the default.
Choose where focus returns. On Windows, closing Settings or another Overkot window can return focus to Soulframe, the overlay, or the desktop. Soulframe is the default.
More reliable widget and menu interaction. Fixed an issue where the overlay could switch to click-through mode while you were using a widget, menu, or dropdown.

Improved live map tracking. Overkot now follows the active game log more reliably after relaunching or leaving a dungeon. Longer player searches resume where they left off, and Settings shows search progress when available.
Overkot's source and releases now live in the public overkot repository.
Group Finder listings, profiles and join requests belong to the signed-in player. Upgrade and recreate your listings to use the new service.
Group Finder follows game logins independently of inventory and clears the previous profile when you switch accounts or sign out.
Open maps refresh after newly authorized map assets finish downloading.
Restored item thumbnails and Temper icons in the Market widget’s Sell from inventory tab.
Overkot now keeps a pending account sign-in active when the account service is busy and retries automatically.
Added Thai, Ukrainian and Traditional Chinese, bringing the language selector to 15 languages. Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese have separate game text and interface settings.
Expanded translations across settings, widgets and guided tours. Community corrections can now be made in the overkot-localisations repository.
Dungeon maps reveal rooms as you explore by default. Turn off “Reveal dungeon as you explore” in Settings → Widgets → Mini-Map to see the full layout as soon as it loads.
We’re preparing Overkot for a future open-source release.
Linux fixes - Added native Wine/Proton player position and facing tracking for the live map, including Arch Linux on Wayland/XWayland.
Dungeon maps on Linux now receive live player and room-frame data so exploration outlines can reveal as you walk.
Fixed Arena Finder missing the Glades wave arena (GoAxDeadendGarrenRood, exported tile 24). The separate Garren Rood boss/quest arena is excluded.
Arena Finder now waits for current dungeon evidence instead of reporting No arena found when layout detection is unavailable.
Debian and Arch packages configure the narrow position reader's process-read capability. AppImage tracking uses normal user permissions and reports blocked access clearly.
Linux-only release: updated DEB, Pacman and AppImage packages; Windows downloads remain on v0.0.15.
Customizable Moonsteel alerts - Monitor-edge flashes and sound alerts, with colour, intensity, duration, pulse speed, monitor selection and volume controls.
Live player map markers on Windows - Track your position and facing on the overworld and in dungeons, with automatic following and recenter controls.
Dungeon exploration reveal - Automatically aligned room outlines reveal as you explore, with discovery remembered for the current dungeon run.
Nearby dropped weapon map markers with weapon names and distinct animated purple indicators for confirmed Moonsteel drops.
New Daily Brief pop-out - Daily allowances, ancestor encounters, Calendar, Avakot's live stock and faction vendor weapons with their daily Tempers. Optionally opens on login and daily reset.
Saved widget layouts - Save, switch, import and export named arrangements, and choose a layout to load at startup.
Precise widget sizing - Enter exact dimensions, resize in 1-pixel steps, fit panels to their content and reset individual widget sizes.
Overlay monitor selection - Choose which monitor displays the bar and attached widgets.
Settings and customisation overhaul - Live appearance previews, per-widget overrides, typography, spacing, corners, borders, progress bars and motion controls.
Shareable appearance presets with import, export, undo and redo.
Independent background, element and inner-surface opacity controls, including per-widget settings.
Visual polish with animated multicolour interface icons, smoother transitions and sharper app and installer icons.
Tutorial controls - Disable automatic tutorials globally or turn them back on while keeping manual replay available.
Updated Daily Affiliation and Ode Infamy tracking to use the game's rank-based daily limits.
Updated weapon mastery thresholds, Envoy Rank calculations and Build Exporter progression calculations.
Updated Wolf Training to reflect the current 150-energy maximum.
More reliable Arena Finder detection, with wave and tier progress cleared correctly between dungeon instances.
Fixed timer alert dismissal and added smoother countdowns with a shorter eight-second popup duration.
Improved dock dragging, widget sizing and window layering so dungeon maps stay below menus and alerts remain visible.
Fixed Market listing controls being clipped with short or filtered inventories.
Redesigned Windows update flow - Startup checks, release notes, download size and speed, and manual Download and Restart and install controls.
Improved Linux overlay visibility above fullscreen games.

New Title Tracker shows epithet challenge progress and completion, with search, completed/incomplete filters, multiple pinned goals and a frameless pinned-only view. Preferences are saved between sessions.
Redesigned Avakot Market uses the shared market interface for browsing, search, profiles, settings and navigation.
Market signs in through the avakot.dev account connected in Settings. Login and Sign up open Connections; existing connections need one Reconnect for Market approval.
Restored Sell from inventory in the Market sidebar and fixed incorrect sign-in prompts, duplicate notices, extra scrollbars, inconsistent styling and listing dialogs opening off-screen.
New Data – Inventory widget offers searchable, grouped inventory with readable item names, expandable details and manual refresh. Saved inventory remains available offline.
New Data – EE.log widget offers log search, severity filters, message details and newest-first or oldest-first ordering.
Added first-use app and widget tutorials, replay controls in Settings and a startup reminder showing the configured focus shortcut.
Temper Tracker now restores views, searches, filters, grouping, hidden controls and collapsed groups between sessions.
Fixed Wiki back, forward, refresh, open-in-browser and close controls becoming unresponsive after searches, including in portable builds.
Improved Settings window rendering and focus restoration; fixed inactive overlay windows intercepting game clicks.

Improved Linux dock alignment, saved widget restoration, attached panel placement, drag snapping and fullscreen visibility. Improved X11/XWayland selection and added display-backend details in Settings.
New screen-edge dock with widget icons, saved icon order, optional auto-hide and a shortcut to hide or restore the overlay.
Hold Shift while the overlay is focused to arrange widgets on a grid, align them and reattach them to the dock.
Dungeon layouts appear in Mini-Map and can expand into a transparent map over the game, with pan, zoom and fit controls.
New Wolf Training widget shows your wolf training progress and bond.
New World Watch widget combines Midrath clock and weather.
Improved Avakot Market browsing, filters and sign-in with avakot.dev.
Choose whether Zenith offerings appear in Calendar; clearer Temper Tracker views and unlock progress.
Widget outlines have their own opacity setting, with more space for content.
Improved click-through and focus handling: the game cursor no longer reveals a collapsed dock, and Escape returns input to Soulframe while preserving the dungeon map.
Fixed dock bounds after taskbar changes, widget dragging on focus loss, and Wiki history, refresh and focus handling.
Improved map loading and dungeon route handling.
Experimental Linux downloads for Debian/Mint, Arch-based desktops and portable AppImage, with native session scanning and manual updates.
Mini-Map now shows your dungeon layout while you're in a dungeon, with a see-through option.
New Wolf Training widget shows your wolf's training progress and bond.
New World Watch widget brings Midrath's clock and weather together.
Improved Market browsing, filters and sign-in with avakot.dev.
Show or hide Zenith's offerings in the Calendar.
Clearer Temper Tracker views and unlock progress.
Improved map loading and overlay controls.
Added experimental Debian and Linux Mint support, including account linking and improved widget controls.
Avakot Market for browsing, selling from inventory, and managing trades.
Redesigned Settings and searchable Widgets picker.
Improved Wiki Search and custom game file locations.
Choose your Windows installation folder.
Ancestor map markers with approximate search areas.
Calendar for ancestor encounters and Zenith's daily offers.
Live Midrath clock with day and night countdowns.
Export your equipped build to avakot.build.
Temper Tracker for tempers across all your weapons.
New Dark Mint, Midnight, Ember and High Contrast themes.
Automatic game data updates and manual refresh in Settings.
Group Finder supports parties of up to four players.
Choose automatic or manual app updates in Settings.
Arena widget tidied up
Improved Faction Standing and Ode Infamy tracking reliability.
Group Finder hardening and minor UI tweaks.
Fixed wiki search window failing to open.
Fixed widget windows behaviour at high-DPI scales.
Docked mode added for widgets, still needs polish.
Added Ode Infamy widget - tracks your Ode Syndicate standing in a compact, single-bar view.
Fixed wiki search widget rendering as a blank window on first open.
Fixed widget resize handle drifting off the rendered corner while dragging by the title bar.
Fixed Group Finder window opening with the bottom action buttons clipped on high-DPI displays (e.g. 4K at 250% scale).
Added Arena Checker widget. Shows 'Not in Glades', 'No arena found', or 'Arena found!' and updates live as you join, leave, or migrate sessions.
Added Mirifuir Siege timer.
Added Captain Carmo duel timers.
Fixed widget windows growing horizontally while being dragged by the title bar.
Fixed minimap collapse - arrow toggle now properly shrinks the widget window and hides bottom controls.
Fixed widgets being draggable off-screen - drag movement is now clamped to display work area boundaries.
Fixed wiki window rendering as a white page - added compositor invalidation on load and error page fallback.
Added 'Show overlay only when Soulframe is focused' setting - overlay auto-hides when alt-tabbing to other apps.
Overlay focus-hide now activates during the 'connecting' phase, not just after fully connected.
Improved focus detection speed - replaced per-call PowerShell spawns with a persistent background monitor (~250ms response).
Fixed overlay requiring a click to resume hiding after re-appearing - windows now restore without stealing focus.
Fixed main window staying hidden after quitting the game - focus-hide state is now properly reset on game exit.
Settings window enlarged so all options are visible without clipping.
Reset Widget Positions and Reset Widget Sizes buttons now display side by side.
Fixed timer notification text not displaying - notifications now show the localized timer name instead of blank.
Fixed timer notifications not closing - X button and 60-second auto-dismiss now work reliably in transparent overlay windows.
Fixed window width continuously growing during drag - removed positive feedback loop in auto-fit width logic and added explicit drag-state suppression.
Seamless auto-updates - new versions are now installed automatically on launch or when the app closes, with no interruptions during use.
Improved update reliability for edge cases where updates could silently fail to install.
Added manual widget resizing - drag the bottom-right handle to resize any widget.
Minimap resize is ratio-locked to keep its square aspect ratio.
Widget sizes now persist between sessions.
Added 'Reset Widget Sizes' button in settings.
Improved main titlebar drag performance - window movement is now throttled to display refresh rate.
Commented out legacy multi-column drag-and-drop code (dead code cleanup).
Commented out legacy widget rendering functions superseded by standalone widget windows.
Removed orphaned CSS for old drag-and-drop layout system.
Added i18n translations for reset buttons across all 12 languages.
Initial release as Overkot.
Live game tracking with automatic detection of Soulframe process and session state (waiting, connecting, connected).
Timer tracking for boss encounters, crafting, and other timed activities.
Daily affiliation progress tracking toward the 16,000 cap.
Faction standing progress tracking across key factions.
Widget-based overlay system with per-widget enable/disable, collapse, and drag-to-reposition.
Widgets run as separate always-on-top windows for custom screen layouts.
Widget state persistence (visibility, collapse, window positions) across sessions.
Widget Picker window for managing active widgets.
Wiki Search widget for quick Soulframe wiki lookups.
Mini-map widget with zoom, pan, legend filters, and map markers.
Expanded world map window with full canvas, hover labels, coordinates, and legend.
"Where am I?" locate flow using in-game screenshots.
Group Finder with Home, Browse, My Listing, and Profile tabs.
Create, browse, and join group listings with request/accept/decline workflows.
Group Finder profile preferences for language and region.
Suggested groups based on compatibility signals.
Timer completion pop-up alerts (stacked and dismissible).
Minimize to system tray with optional launch-to-tray behaviour.
Cached data restores recent timers and progress on startup before live reconnect.
Optional auto-hide of widgets and popouts when Soulframe is not running.
12-language UI support.
Configurable colours and opacity for text, bars, and backgrounds.
Click-through overlay mode with configurable hotkey for temporary interaction.
Settings window for language, visuals, alert behaviour, tray, and hide preferences.
Changelog window for viewing release notes.
